parsed.text: This packet contains fallible location distributions for red and blue roles at nodes n0–n3 in two panels (p0, p1). Current estimates (represented_time 13 or copied prior represented_time 12 as noted in origins) are given per panel. Panel p0 current: blue peaks at n0=[0,1] and n3=[1,2]; red peaks at n0=[0,3] and n3=[0,1]; nodes n1 and n2 are uniform for both roles. Panel p1 current: blue peaks on a 2×2 block at n3 (cells [0,2],[0,3],[1,2],[1,3]); red peaks on a 2×2 block at n3 (cells [0,0],[0,1],[1,0],[1,1]); n0 shows single-cell peaks and n1–n2 are uniform. Candidate command records (k0,k1,k2) are conditional estimates, not events that occurred; copied prior records are not new estimates. Differences across candidates are present mainly at panel p1 node n3: k0 matches the 2×2 block, k1 shows uniform peaks, and k2 concentrates at a single cell [1,2].
